title: Finite-size, quantum-hardware accuracy, and package-shape gates for a sub-kelvin Na2BaCo(PO4)2 magnetic-refrigerator stage
description: Reproducible public-data analysis of how finite-size model transfer, weak magnetic interactions, quantum-hardware error, and package demagnetization affect sub-kelvin magnetic-refrigerator decisions for Na2BaCo(PO4)2. The release includes a four-model N=18 transfer gate, a complete nine-circuit IBM Kingston entropy-correction benchmark, engineering decision maps, and package and measurement specifications. The QPU resolves the correction sign but not its quantitative magnitude; no quantum advantage is claimed.
